Surge distribution FITTED: GEV (Coles) by maximum likelihood, loc 0.6900 m, scale 0.1353 m, shape -0.1319, to annual maxima of the tide-removed surge residual at NOAA CO-OPS station 8418150 (Portland, Maine), 1980-2025, n = 46. Cross-checked in extRemes.
Citation: Surge distribution fitted by maximum likelihood (GEV) to 46 annual maxima of tide-removed surge residual, NOAA CO-OPS 8418150 (Portland, Maine), 1980-2025; cross-checked in R (extRemes).
Tide amplitude (1.40 m) is ASSUMED, not verified against the published NOAA datums for the station.
Fitted surge is meteorological residual only: sea level rise was removed before fitting and must be added separately to still water level.
Depth-damage curve is illustrative; shape is plausible, ordinates are not sourced.
Tide and surge peaks assumed coincident (conservative joint-occurrence case).
Wave setup, wave overtopping, rainfall and groundwater are not modelled.
Local-inertial scheme omits advective acceleration; valid for floodplain flow, not for supercritical or strongly advective flow.
